title: 19-Year-Old Liquor Shoplifter Goes To Jail Over $90 Worth Of Alcohol
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 6th, 2023. Officers.  Officers received a call from a liquor store in regards to a habitual 19-year-old shoplifter who kept stealing liquor from the store. When the officers spoke to her, she originally lied and said she didn't steal anything, however as time grew she started to confess and said she stole earlier that week. When the officer asked to search the vehicle, she said no which raised suspicion. Due to her car being towed, it gave the officer a chance to search the vehicle and they found her to have 3 stolen bottles of alcohol.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
